            Chat with us

            Privacy Policy

            Who we are: Victory Dynasty LLC, Albuquerque, New Mexico, USA. Contact: victorydynasty9@gmail.com.

            What we collect: if you use Chat with us, we store your messages, a random Guest ID, the page you were on, and the time. We do not ask for your name, an account, or payment details in chat. Please never send passwords or card numbers.

            On your device: your Guest ID, chat history and a chat token are kept in your browser storage so your conversation continues. We do not use advertising cookies on this site.

            Why: to answer your questions and to keep the service safe (spam and abuse prevention).

            Who sees it: our team and our hosting providers: Cloudflare, Inc. (website hosting and security) and the provider of our chat server. Links to Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and Pinterest leave this site and follow their own privacy policies.

            How long: chats are deleted automatically after 150 days of inactivity. Ask us at victorydynasty9@gmail.com to see or delete your chat (send your Guest ID).

            Age: this site is for adults only (18+, or the legal age where you live).

            Terms of Use

            Eligibility: you must be 18+ (or the legal age in your location). You are responsible for following the laws where you live.

            Third-party games: game names and logos belong to their owners. We do not own them. Availability may vary and can change without notice.

            No guarantees: the site and chat are provided “as is”. Replies are not instant, and nothing here is an offer of winnings, income, or advice.

            Acceptable use: no abuse, spam, hacking attempts, or illegal activity. We may block access to protect the service.

            Liability: to the extent allowed by law, Victory Dynasty LLC is not liable for indirect or consequential losses.

            Governing law: the laws of the State of New Mexico, USA. Contact: victorydynasty9@gmail.com.

            Responsible Play

            Play for fun, not to make money. Only use money you can afford to lose, set a time and spend limit before you start, and take regular breaks. Never chase losses and never borrow to play.

            If gaming stops being fun or you feel you cannot stop, free confidential help is available in the USA: call or text 1-800-GAMBLER (1-800-426-2537) or visit ncpgambling.org. Please verify this contact is still current.

            Minors must not use this site. Parents can use free tools such as device parental controls.
